description: Dim interior of a room with dark curtains. On the left, an old wood-cabinet CRT television on a stand shows a jet airliner on a tarmac under a pale dawn sky. On the right, a tall multi-pane window looks out on a columned building with a crowd on its steps, a long green lawn running toward a tall obelisk (Washington Monument) under a grey sky. A bare tree in front of the window has yellow ribbons tied to its branches. No people are clearly identifiable.
